Decider.description: Who decided an `attested` or `skipped` task, and why.

Red.description: The red run's output, bounded and checked clean (revision 2).

excerpt.description: The last bytes of the output (at most 2048); `null` when withheld.

output_sha256.description: sha256 of the captured output the excerpt was cut from.

withheld.description: The excerpt was not clean (a local path, a credential): dropped.

RedKind.description: How the acceptance tests first failed (revision 2).

oneOf.description: Because what the task introduces did not exist yet.

SpecRef.description: The requirement the task belongs to.

section.description: The requirement or story, e.g. `US1`; `null`: none.

section_hash.description: sha256 of that requirement's text as the attempt was given it.

line_hash.description: sha256 of the task line with its box read as open (before the tick).

Unit.description: The spec unit (feature, change) the task belongs to.

description:
The `task-verification` predicate, v0.

Fields `null` in a tick may be absent in a decision (`attested`,
`skipped`), which carries `decider` instead of the test evidence.

acceptance.description:
Where the acceptance tests were decided —
`{ source: authored|review|bug_confirmation|person_test, pre_frozen }`.
Opaque here.

bug.description:
A bug task's evidence: where the bug lives, its triad's digest, the
outcome, the reproductions' discrimination, special-case rejections
and the pass-to-pass set. Opaque to the verifier.

context.description: Reserved: what reached the model, by digest. Opaque here.

decisions.description: People's decisions on the attempt's calls.

dependencies.description:
Reserved: dependencies the change added, with their
registry checksums. Opaque here.

instructions.description: Repository instruction files given to the attempt.

model.description: The judging model: `{ provider, model }`, or `null`.

monitor.description: The gaming monitor: `{ state: clean|suspected|unreviewed|off, findings }`.

policy_sha256.description: sha256 of the judge's configuration at the parent commit.

sandbox.description: Where the attempt ran: `{ mode, backend, network }`.

spec.description: The requirement and its text's hash (ticks).

strength.description:
The acceptance set's strength (shares, near misses, permitted
alternatives), or `null`.

trace.description: Requirement → scenario → test rows, each with its phase and result.

title: https://speccoder.dev/task-verification/v0 (revision 2)
